name: Laying the Fairies
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Laying the Fairies is a folk belief. The one way to be rid of fairies was to give them a gift. Fairies, above all brownies, helped in their own way. When given clothes or a payment they left. The owner was then said to have laid them.

okr.objective: Describe the folk belief of laying the fairies.
key_results: The way to end a fairy was to give it a gift.
Brownies helped in their own way.
A gift from the owner made the fairy leave.
